directory_policy: Discovery only. Follow through to official organizer/program and current cycle before asserting dates, benefits or eligibility.
evolution_policy: Track family yields and official-source conversion. Propose query refinements in run notes; retain broad family coverage. Never change scoring weights automatically.
credit_policy: Screenshots and directory maxima are discovery leads only. Verify current tier, referral/VC requirements, supported products, expiration, renewal, paid-account/deposit conditions and company-email rules. Never equate credits with cash, guarantee acceptance, or accept terms automatically.
program_seeds: 5x5 Night (Start Garden, GVSU Muskegon Innovation Hub)
AARP AgeTech Collaborative pitch events (AgeTech After Dark at CES)
money_policy: Any money that can reach the founders counts: cash prizes, grants, fellowships and stipends paid to individual founders, hackathon prizes, and investment programs. Rank non-dilutive cash first, then investment. Label investment and SAFE terms plainly and never call them grants. Founder-personal programs are judged on founder eligibility (age, student status, location), not company traction; leave unknown eligibility null. Report the next cycle when the current one has closed, with the date it is expected to reopen if published.
perk_policy: Free tools, software, ad credits, fee waivers, space and expert help count as money A Story does not have to spend. Record them as startup programs with what is free, for how long and the conditions. Never call a free trial a grant and never equate a perk with cash.
